content.title: About
content.content: Ensure is a ready-to-drink nutritional beverage designed to support daily dietary needs. It provides a balanced blend of proteins, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins, and minerals, making it a convenient way to obtain essential nutrients anytime.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The product was first launched in the 1970s by Abbott Laboratories.
It is available in several flavors: vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, and neutral.
Each 250 ml serving delivers about 20 % of the daily value for vitamin D and over 30 % of the daily value for calcium.
Ensure is frequently used in clinical settings for patients with increased nutritional needs, such as post‑surgery or chronic illness.
The drink requires no preparation – it can be consumed straight from the bottle.

items.title: Supports energy balance
items.content: A mix of fast‑ and slow‑release carbohydrates provides a steady supply of energy throughout the day.

items.title: High‑quality protein source
items.content: Each serving contains about 10 g of whey protein, which helps maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6, and B12 support normal nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Source of calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Helps maintain bone and dental health, especially for individuals with higher needs.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The liquid form is gentle on the stomach, suitable for people with chewing or swallowing difficulties.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some flavors contain up to 20 g of sugar per serving, which may be a concern for diabetics.

items.title: Milk‑protein allergy
items.content: The product is based on whey protein; those allergic to dairy should choose a non‑dairy alternative.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: One serving provides roughly 220 kcal, so it should be accounted for in total daily calorie intake.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: High calcium levels can affect absorption of certain antibiotics; it is recommended to take medicines at least 2 hours before or after the drink.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Keep the shake refrigerated after opening and consume within 48 hours. It can be taken as a standalone meal replacement or as a supplement to regular meals, for example after a workout or before bedtime.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and use within 2 days.
